SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
File No.
No. D 4810.
Special Branch S.B. Station, 1938
Date April 26, 1938.
REPORT
Subject (in full) Assistance to Chinese Authorities -- attempt to arrest
one Siao Yoong Sung (蕭榮生).
Made by D.S.I. Everest Forwarded by [签名]
At 8.45 p.m. April 26 an unsuccessful attempt was
made by members of the Special Branch, Hongkew Station and
the Public Safety Bureau to effect the arrest of an alleged
member of the 2nd Section (Intelligence) of the Special Squad
of the Chinese Communist Party named Siao Yoong Sung (蕭榮生)
at No. P.a.3, Lane 152, Tsepoo Road.
Circumstances leading to the above action being taken,
particulars of which were supplied by Supt. Tan Shao-liang,
are as follows:-
At 5 p.m. April 26 a communist named Zung Yui Ching
(陳裕錦), age 25, native of Anhwei, was arrested by the Chinese
Authorities in the vicinity of the Small East Gate, Nantao.
The arrested person, who is stated to be the "Clerk" of the
General Union of Printers of the Communist Party, subsequently
divulged information that he was working for a member of the
2nd Section of the Special Squad of the Chinese Communist Party
named Siao Yoong Sung. He further stated that he had
arranged to meet this man either between 8 and 9 p.m. April 26
or 3 and 4 p.m. April 27 in the back ground floor room of No.
P.a.3, Lane 152, Tsepoo Road, which was tenanted by an ex-
communist named Lee (李). At 8.30 p.m. the same evening
1st Class Detective Daung Pao of the Public Safety Bureau
presented himself at Hongkew Station with the prisoner Zung
Yui Ching and requested assistance in visiting the address at
Tsepoo Road. Assistance was given by D.S. Self, C.D.C's 62
and 259 (Hongkew), D.S.I. Everest, D.S. Jones and Clerk Zung
Zoong Oem (Special Branch). Neither the wanted man Siao
Yoong Sung nor the tenant of the room were present and no
arrests were made.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处
档案号
第 D 4810 号。
特别支部，虹口分站，1938年
日期：1938年4月26日。
报告
事由（全称）：协助中国当局——试图逮捕一名叫萧荣生（Siao Yoong Sung）的人。
呈报人：警司 Everest 转交人：[签名]
4月26日晚8时45分，特别支部虹口分站成员与公共安全局人员试图在乍浦路152弄P.a.3号逮捕一名据称为中国共产党特别队第二科（情报科）成员的萧荣生（Siao Yoong Sung），但未获成功。
导致采取上述行动的情况如下，相关细节由谭绍良（Tan Shao-liang）督察提供：
4月26日下午5时，一名名叫陈裕锦（Zung Yui Ching）、25岁、安徽籍的共产党员，在中国当局于南市小东门附近将其逮捕。
被捕者据称是共产党印刷工人总工会的“文书”，随后供出他正为中国共产党特别队第二科的一名成员萧荣生工作。他还表示，已约定于4月26日晚8时至9时之间，或4月27日下午3时至4时之间，在乍浦路152弄P.a.3号的后底楼房间与该人会面，该房间由一名前共产党员李（Lee）承租。当晚8时30分，公共安全局一等侦探党宝（Daung Pao）带着囚犯陈裕锦来到虹口分站，请求协助前往乍浦路的上述地址。特别支部警司 Self、虹口分站第62号和第259号中国侦探、警司 Everest、警司 Jones 以及特别支部文员钟宗恩（Zung Zoong Oem，音译）提供了协助。被通缉者萧荣生及该房间承租人均不在场，因此未实施逮捕。
